title: C Programming Beginner Mock Test 1
description: Comprehensive 50-minute mock examination for C Programming at beginner level.

questions.prompt: Which statement accurately describes preprocessing in C?

The language automatically repairs the issue

questions.explanation: preprocessing handles directives before compilation. Verify with strict warnings, a minimal program, and observable output.
